description: Short real-run smoke for 10_inst_disc: pretrain -> encoder.pt -> linear_eval, one epoch on tiny real-shaped ImageFolder data. Discovered and driven by tests/test_real_run_smoke.py and bin/matrix-run.py (docs/REAL_RUN_VERIFICATION.md steps 2-3). It lives in the method's own directory so no shared file names a method (tests/test_no_hard_coded_methods.py). The override keys match this method's config schema (train.img_size, not image_size) -- they are not copied from another method.
